SC-001.successCondition: The source or details view for one discovered customization file is visibly open and operable within two minutes of the prompt.
SC-001.timerStart: the moment the standardized prompt is presented
SC-001.timerStop: the moment that view is visibly open and operable
included: using the printed URL when no browser opens

SC-006.successCondition: All three response fields are submitted within two minutes and every field matches the ground truth.
SC-006.timerStart: the moment the prepared state is ready and the prompt is presented
SC-006.timerStop: the moment the form is submitted

comparison.successCondition: The two copies are side by side and one difference is named.

consent.successCondition: The personal-setup page is reached and the directories it names are read back.

unsuccessful: a missing or incorrect response field
an equipment, environment, or product failure that prevents or interrupts the attempt
moderatorPolicy: The standardized prompt may be repeated verbatim. No command, navigation, or interface-operation hint may be given, for either criterion or for the untimed workflow tasks.
